    v1.0.3 — Performance & local data persistence

    29 Oct 2026 · Current release
    • Reduced redundant chart and mouse-interaction work intended to improve tab responsiveness.

    • Browser-local storage remains specific to this browser profile and website origin.

    v1.0.2 — Dashboard interaction improvements

    29 Oct 2026
    • Adjusted chart hover behavior and reduced unnecessary visual effects.
    • Added safeguards intended to avoid repeated chart reconfiguration.

    v1.0.1 — Pie chart interaction

    29 Oct 2026
    • Improved mouse interaction and hover feedback for employee pie charts.

    v1.0.0 — Dashboard baseline

    Initial release
    • Existing store sales dashboard, reports, tabs, and Excel upload workflow.
